text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. When you plan a project, it also helps to break it into smaller steps called milestones. These allow you to track progress and stay motivated. You should also define your deliverables—the final products or results you must complete. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the start. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
